name: Annual leave (วันหยุดพักผ่อนประจำปี)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.30, 56, 67
references.quote: At least 12 working days of annual leave a year after one year of service; current-year leave is pro-rated on qualifying termination and accumulated leave is paid on either-party termination.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.32, 57
references.quote: Sick leave is for actual illness; wages are owed for up to 30 working days a year.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.32, 57
references.quote: Sick leave beyond 30 paid working days a year is unpaid.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.34, 57/1
references.quote: At least 3 working days a year for necessary business; wages are owed for up to 3 days.

name: Sterilisation leave (ลาเพื่อทำหมัน)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.33, 57
references.quote: Leave is allowed for sterilisation and the period a physician certifies, with wages.

name: Military service leave (ลารับราชการทหาร)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.35, 58
references.quote: Leave is allowed for military inspection, call-up or training, with wages for up to 60 days a year.

name: Training leave (ลาฝึกอบรม)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.36
references.quote: Training or development leave is allowed under the Ministerial Regulation; the Act does not require wages.

name: Training or meeting leave for an employee under 18 (ลาของลูกจ้างซึ่งเป็นเด็ก)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.52
references.quote: An employee under 18 may take up to 30 days a year for approved training, meetings or courses, with wages.

name: Maternity leave, employer-paid days (ลาคลอด)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.41, 59 (before Act No. 9 B.E. 2568)
references.quote: Up to 98 days of maternity leave per pregnancy including holidays; wages for up to 45 days. Applied until 6 December 2025.

name: Maternity leave, days without employer pay

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.41; Social Security Act B.E. 2533 (1990) s.67
references.quote: 98 days of maternity leave less 45 employer-paid days; the Social Security Fund pays a maternity benefit at 50 percent of wages for 90 days.

name: Traditional holidays (วันหยุดตามประเพณี)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.29, 56(2)
references.quote: At least 13 traditional holidays a year, announced in advance, with wages.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.5, 70
references.quote: Wages are owed for work and the paid leave the Act lists; other leave agreed with the employer is unpaid.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.32 para 3; Workmen's Compensation Act B.E. 2537 s.18(1)
references.quote: A work injury or work illness is not sick leave; the Workmen's Compensation Fund pays 70 percent of the monthly wage while the employee cannot work.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.116-117
references.quote: Suspension pending an investigation is at most 7 days and paid at not less than 50 percent of the working-day wage; a cleared employee gets the full wage plus 15 percent a year interest.
